copiedFrom: Words copied on Oct 23, 2026 from the public pages of the club's current website (collegeclubseattle.com): Home, Membership and Contact. The directors' own email addresses are deliberately left out (Grant, Oct 23): the one public email is the membership address. The About and Rowing and fitness pages are placeholders that use only sentences from those public pages, because the current site's own pages for them are for members only.

sections.heading: A membership for you and your family
paragraphs: Questions about membership? Email membership@collegeclubseattle.com or call (206) 622-0624.

sections.heading: Every membership includes
paragraphs: Club hours: 5am-8pm, seven days a week. Members have fob access 24/7. (Office hours: Mon-Fri 8am-4pm, Sat by appointment.)
bullets: Access to quality rowing classes and equipment.
Rowing shells, kayaks, and paddle boards for your whole family.
Lake Union waterfront access on our oversized floating dock for picnics, sun bathing, water activities, and club events.
Members Lounge boasting panoramic views of Lake Union and the Seattle skyline, a BBQ deck, a large river rock fireplace, billiards, darts, shuffleboard and TV's.
Use of our full gym and cardio room with RP3 and Concept 2 ergs, bicycles, free weights, and more.
Access to events including dock concerts, trivia, game nights, and so much more!
College Club Seattle is the proud owner of multiple sets of Seahawks season tickets as well as UW Husky Football season tickets. These are offered to our members annually with limited availability.
